# DuckOS

> Linux network operating platform in development for routers, gateways and
> VPS/edge nodes. Not a supported production release. Open-source publication
> and license selection remain pending.

## Overview

- [Project](PROJECT.md): goals, principles, targets and architecture.
- [README](README.md): current capabilities and limitations.
- [Requirements](docs/requirements/product.md): complete product intent, not availability claims.

## Guides

- [Installation](docs/install.md): fresh Debian TEST installer and artifact verification.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md): API, Engine, privileged Agent and Linux boundaries.
- [Networking](docs/use-cases/home-gateway.md): home and small-business gateway requirements.
- [Routing](docs/use-cases/routing.md): selective routing and multi-WAN qualification.
- [Edge nodes](docs/use-cases/edge-node.md): single-NIC management and VPN design.
- [WireGuard, Xray and subscriptions](docs/use-cases/client-provisioning.md): planned client provisioning and secret exports.
- [API](shared/api/README.md): documented contracts.
- [Security](docs/security-model.md): trust, management, identity and secrets.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): current diagnostics and safe reporting.
- [Updates](docs/update-system.md): signed packages and Active/Previous requirements.
- [Releases](docs/launch/release-notes.md): release record contract; none published.
- [Hardware](docs/hardware-compatibility.md): evidence and compatibility report statuses.
